name: CodeOrbitTech_Portfolio
description: A premium, recruiter-friendly portfolio website built using HTML, CSS, and Vanilla JavaScript with modern UI/UX and responsive design.

paragraphs: A modern, highly interactive, and premium-quality developer portfolio website built using HTML5, CSS3 (Vanilla), and Vanilla JavaScript. This template features a sleek dark mode backdrop, frosted glassmorphism elements, custom timelines, brand-colored skill badges, and a custom hacker-themed code symbol cursor trail.
features: Cyber Code-Symbol Cursor Trail: An interactive custom HTML5 Canvas background that emits floating code symbols ({, }, , 0, 1, git, npm, fn, etc.) behind the cursor on mouse movement. The symbols rotate slightly, float…

Dynamic Spanning Grid: A customized 4-column desktop layout that dynamically groups 10 core languages/skills into a 3-column-wide card and tools into a 1-column-wide card, adapting seamlessly down to 2 columns on…
Animated Skills Badges: Eliminates boring skill trackers/progress bars in favor of modern glassmorphic tags featuring official brand logos and colors.
Organic Morphing Profile blob: A floating, morphing photo frame in the Hero section with a glowing gradient border, properly masked to keep your photo cropped inside the blob contours.
